project.title: Launch of a Seasonal Healthy Lunch Menu
project.objective: Design, test, and roll out a cost-controlled, healthy seasonal lunch menu that fits existing kitchen capacity and food safety standards.
deliverables: Final seasonal lunch menu with recipes and portions
Standardised recipe cards with preparation steps and timings
Costing sheet per dish with target food cost percentage
Prep and service station layout plan for the new menu
Food safety and allergen reference for all new dishes
constraints: Menu must be fully operational within 21 days
Use only existing kitchen equipment and storage capacity
Respect food safety and hygiene regulations at all times
Keep average food cost per dish within agreed target range
Menu must include vegetarian and low-allergen options

risks.risk: New dishes take longer to prepare than current service window allows.
risks.mitigation: Run timed test services and adjust prep steps, batch cooking, or simplify recipes before launch.

risks.risk: Ingredient costs exceed target food cost percentage.
risks.mitigation: Compare suppliers, adjust portion sizes, and substitute ingredients while keeping taste and quality.

risks.risk: Staff are not fully aligned on new recipes and plating standards.
risks.mitigation: Create clear recipe cards, run training sessions, and do trial services with feedback checklists.

risks.risk: Allergen or dietary information is incomplete or inconsistent.
risks.mitigation: Document ingredients per dish, double-check labels, and have a single reference sheet at the pass.

themes.why_relevant: Cooks must align on variety, nutrition, and feasibility of the seasonal lunch dishes.
Keeping food cost on target requires strict portion sizes and smart ingredient choices.
New dishes must fit existing prep routines and service speed without overloading the team.
All recipes must comply with hygiene rules and have clear allergen information for service staff.

themes.theme: Testing and feedback from trial services
themes.why_relevant: Trial runs help refine recipes, plating, and timing before full rollout.

backlog.task: Draft initial list of seasonal healthy lunch dishes with basic descriptions
definition_of_done: List includes at least 8 candidate dishes with short descriptions
Each dish tagged as meat, fish, vegetarian, or vegan
List shared in channel and agreed as base for recipe work

backlog.task: Develop and document standardised recipes for selected dishes
definition_of_done: Each selected dish has a full recipe with ingredients and steps
Portion sizes and yields are clearly specified
Recipes stored in shared recipe document

backlog.task: Create costing sheet for each new dish using current supplier prices
definition_of_done: All ingredients per dish have unit cost and quantity
Food cost percentage calculated for each dish
Dishes above target flagged with suggestions to adjust

backlog.task: Define prep schedule and batch cooking plan for new menu
definition_of_done: Daily prep list created with timings and responsibilities
Cold and hot prep separated with storage instructions
Plan validated against current staffing and opening hours

backlog.task: Design plating and service guidelines for each dish
definition_of_done: Plating description or sketch for each dish documented
Standard garnish and sauce placement defined
Guidelines reviewed during a short team walkthrough

backlog.task: Compile allergen and dietary information for all new dishes
definition_of_done: All 14 major allergens checked per dish
Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free flags added
Single allergen reference sheet created and shared

backlog.task: Run a small internal tasting and timing session for the new menu
definition_of_done: At least one full run of each dish completed and timed
Taste and timing feedback captured in tasting notes
List of recipe or process adjustments agreed

backlog.task: Adjust recipes and prep steps based on tasting feedback
definition_of_done: Recipe cards updated with any changes
Timing issues addressed via prep or batch changes
Updated versions shared and old versions archived

backlog.task: Prepare cleaning and food safety checklist specific to new menu prep
definition_of_done: Checklist covers critical control points for new dishes
Includes storage, cooling, reheating, and cross-contamination
Checklist printed or made visible in prep area

backlog.task: Coordinate with front-of-house on menu descriptions and service notes
definition_of_done: Plain-language dish descriptions drafted for menu or boards
Key selling points and allergen notes highlighted
Front-of-house feedback captured and final text agreed

backlog.task: Plan launch week service adjustments and backup options
definition_of_done: Launch week service plan drafted with expected volumes
Backup dishes or substitutions defined for key items
Plan shared with whole kitchen team

backlog.task: Set up simple tracking of sales and waste for new menu items
definition_of_done: Daily log format created for portions sold and waste
Team briefed on how to record data
Tracking ready to use from launch day

artifacts.used_for: Calculates ingredient costs and food cost percentage per dish and tracks adjustments.

artifacts.used_for: Ensures all critical prep, cleaning, and safety steps are followed for the new menu.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on candidate dishes and lock the final seasonal lunch menu list.
threads_plan.trigger: Initial post sharing A1 Seasonal Lunch Menu Draft for review and comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on which candidate dishes from A1 move forward to full recipe development.
Decide how many vegetarian and vegan options must be on the final menu.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define recipes, portions, and costing for each approved dish.
threads_plan.trigger: Cook shares first version of A2 Standard Recipe Cards Pack and A3 costing sheet.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm standard portion sizes for each dish to hit target food cost.
Approve any ingredient substitutions needed to stay within budget.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up prep workflow, food safety checklist, and allergen reference.
threads_plan.trigger: Post summarising proposed prep schedule and sharing drafts of A4 and A6.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final daily prep schedule and responsibilities for new dishes.
Validate allergen and dietary information for all dishes in A6.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run tasting, refine recipes, and lock plating and service guidelines.
threads_plan.trigger: After first internal tasting, cooks share A7 Tasting Notes and draft A5 Plating Guide.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final recipe adjustments based on tasting feedback.
Approve final plating standards and service notes for launch.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan launch week operations and agree on tracking of sales and waste.
threads_plan.trigger: Cook posts draft launch week plan and shares A8 Sales and Waste Log template.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm launch date and any temporary menu reductions during rollout.
Agree on how and when the team will record sales and waste in A8.

channel_rituals: Daily short async prep check-in each morning to flag issues with ingredients or timing.
Post-tasting debrief thread after each tasting session to capture feedback and next steps.
Launch week end-of-day recap summarising sales, waste, and any incidents from A8.
Weekly planning message reviewing upcoming prep changes or menu tweaks.

project.title: Hybrid Workplace Wellbeing & Client Visit Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a structured wellbeing and client-visit experience program for hybrid offices to improve employee health and client satisfaction.
deliverables: Standardised hybrid workplace wellbeing guidelines
Client visit playbook and on-site visit checklist
Quarterly wellbeing and client feedback survey templates
Centralised schedule for client visits and wellbeing activities
Training session for assistants and account managers on new processes
constraints: Program must be launch-ready within 21 days
No additional headcount; use existing staff and tools
Comply with workplace health and safety regulations
Client visits must not disrupt critical business operations
All materials must be available in at least two languages

risks.risk: Low engagement from employees and clients with the new program.
risks.mitigation: Involve representatives in design, run a pilot, and adjust based on early feedback.

risks.risk: Scheduling conflicts between client visits and wellbeing activities.
risks.mitigation: Create a shared calendar with clear priorities and approval rules.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with health and safety or privacy regulations.
risks.mitigation: Have HR and legal review guidelines and survey templates before launch.

risks.risk: Overload of management assistants with coordination tasks.
risks.mitigation: Standardise templates, automate reminders, and limit number of parallel activities.

themes.why_relevant: Need clear routines that work for both on-site and remote days.
Occupational therapist leads evidence-based activities and safeguards health.
Sales account manager must align visits with wellbeing-focused office experience.
Management assistants coordinate calendars, rooms, and communications.
Surveys and reports are needed to refine the program after launch.

backlog.task: Draft hybrid workplace wellbeing guidelines for on-site and remote days
definition_of_done: Guidelines cover physical, mental, and ergonomic aspects
Reviewed by HR and operations manager
Available in two languages
Uploaded to shared drive and linked in internal comms

backlog.task: Design standard client visit playbook aligned with wellbeing program
definition_of_done: Playbook covers pre-visit, on-site, and follow-up steps
Includes wellbeing-friendly office tour script
Validated by occupational therapist and operations manager
Shared with all account managers

backlog.task: Create on-site client visit checklist for reception and assistants
definition_of_done: Checklist includes room setup, safety, refreshments, and materials
Reviewed by sales account manager and occupational therapist
Printed template ready at reception and digital version stored centrally

backlog.task: Set up centralised calendar for client visits and wellbeing activities
definition_of_done: Shared calendar created in existing office system
Access rights defined for all relevant roles
Color-coding and naming conventions documented
Test event created and confirmed by all stakeholders

backlog.task: Prepare quarterly wellbeing and client satisfaction survey templates
definition_of_done: Two survey templates created: employees and clients
Questions reviewed by HR for compliance and clarity
Surveys tested internally with at least 5 respondents
Survey links documented in program overview

backlog.task: Draft internal communication plan for program launch
definition_of_done: Launch email draft prepared in two languages
Short FAQ created for employees and client-facing staff
Communication timeline agreed with HR and sales account manager
Messages scheduled or assigned in office system

backlog.task: Align client segmentation and visit priorities with new program
definition_of_done: Client segments defined with visit frequency guidelines
Priority rules documented and shared with assistants
At least 10 key accounts mapped to visit slots
Playbook updated with segmentation section

backlog.task: Create training session agenda for assistants and account managers
definition_of_done: Agenda covers guidelines, playbook, calendar, and surveys
Timeboxed to max 60 minutes with Q&A
Speakers confirmed: occupational therapist and sales account manager
Session date booked in shared calendar

backlog.task: Define simple reporting template for monthly program status
definition_of_done: Template includes key activities, attendance, and issues
Reviewed by occupational therapist and sales account manager
Stored in shared folder with clear naming convention
Example report filled for pilot month

backlog.task: Pilot the program with one office and a small client group
definition_of_done: At least 3 client visits and 2 wellbeing activities completed
Checklists used and stored for each event
Feedback collected via survey templates
Summary of pilot findings shared in channel

backlog.task: Review legal and compliance aspects of surveys and guidelines
definition_of_done: Documents sent to HR/legal for review
Feedback received and incorporated
Final versions marked as approved in shared drive
Approval status communicated in channel

backlog.task: Document post-launch continuous improvement process
definition_of_done: Process describes how feedback is collected and prioritised
Roles and responsibilities clearly assigned
Review cadence (monthly/quarterly) defined
Process shared and acknowledged in channel

artifacts.title: Hybrid Workplace Wellbeing Guidelines
artifacts.used_for: Reference for employees and managers on daily wellbeing practices on-site and remote.

artifacts.title: Client Visit Playbook

project.title: Standardise Payroll and Office Documentation Workflow
project.objective: Design and roll out a unified, compliant workflow for payroll processing and office document handling to reduce errors and improve turnaround time.
deliverables: End-to-end payroll processing workflow description
Standard operating procedure for document intake and archiving
Shared payroll and document tracking sheet
Access and confidentiality guideline for payroll and HR docs
Checklist for monthly payroll close and reconciliations
constraints: All workflows must comply with tax and labour regulations
No new paid software tools; use existing office suite only
Go-live within current quarter with at least one full payroll cycle
Maintain information confidentiality at all stages
Minimal disruption to ongoing payroll and office operations

risks.risk: Incorrect interpretation of tax or labour rules in the new workflow.
risks.mitigation: Have HR and finance manager review all payroll steps and sign off before go-live.

risks.risk: Staff resist changing existing informal document handling habits.
risks.mitigation: Run short training sessions, share clear checklists, and gather feedback for quick adjustments.

risks.risk: Data loss or misfiling during migration to the new archiving structure.
risks.mitigation: Pilot with a single month of data, keep backups of old folders, and validate samples after migration.

risks.risk: Tight payroll deadlines cause partial adoption of the new process.
risks.mitigation: Phase rollout over two cycles and keep a fallback path documented for urgent cases.

themes.why_relevant: Core objective is to make each payroll run consistent, traceable, and on time.
Office clerks must route forms and correspondence correctly to support payroll accuracy.
Payroll and HR documents contain sensitive data that must be protected.
Team needs a shared way to log, trace, and fix discrepancies in wages and records.
New workflows must be easy to adopt by current and future clerical staff.

definition_of_done: All existing payroll steps listed in sequence

project.title: Launch of Tiered Membership Program for Key Customer Segments
project.objective: Design and roll out a new tiered membership program to increase retention and upsell opportunities across priority customer segments.
deliverables: Tiered membership structure with benefits, pricing, and eligibility rules
End-to-end membership operations playbook for sales and membership teams
Updated membership database fields and reporting definitions
Launch campaign plan for existing and new members
Standard scripts and FAQs for handling member queries and complaints
constraints: Program must be launch-ready within 21 days
No changes to core billing platform; only configuration and process changes allowed
Compliance with data protection and marketing consent policies
Membership benefits must be margin-positive within 6 months
Sales incentives must align with existing compensation framework

risks.risk: Overly complex tier structure confuses members and staff.
risks.mitigation: Limit to 3 tiers, validate with quick internal pilot and adjust based on feedback.

risks.risk: Sales team oversells benefits or miscommunicates eligibility.
risks.mitigation: Provide clear scripts, quick reference guides, and mandatory briefing sessions.

risks.risk: Data quality issues in existing membership database impact targeting and reporting.
risks.mitigation: Run pre-launch data audit and define minimum data standards and clean-up tasks.

risks.risk: Benefits erode margins due to underestimated usage.
risks.mitigation: Model scenarios with finance and set caps/conditions on high-cost benefits.

themes.why_relevant: Defines how attractive and understandable the new membership offer is.
Both teams must execute consistently for a smooth launch.
Accurate tracking is needed to measure uptake and retention impact.
Clear messaging reduces complaints and churn risk.
Ensures issues are handled quickly without disrupting daily operations.

backlog.task: Define membership tiers, benefits, and pricing for three key customer segments
definition_of_done: Three tiers documented with clear eligibility rules and pricing
Benefits list validated with finance for margin impact
Tier overview shared with sales manager for feedback

backlog.task: Design sales pitch framework and objection-handling guide for new tiers
definition_of_done: Pitch outline created for each tier
Top 10 objections with recommended responses documented
Guide reviewed and approved by membership manager

backlog.task: Create membership operations playbook covering onboarding, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations
definition_of_done: Process flows documented for all key membership lifecycle events
Roles and responsibilities clarified for sales and membership teams
Playbook shared with stakeholders and feedback incorporated

backlog.task: Define data fields and tagging rules in membership database for new tiers
definition_of_done: List of required fields and values finalized
Tagging rules for tiers and segments documented
Data standards agreed with sales manager and customer service manager

backlog.task: Plan and schedule internal training sessions for sales and membership teams
definition_of_done: Training agenda and materials drafted
Training dates confirmed with team leads
Attendance tracking approach agreed

backlog.task: Draft external launch communication plan for existing members
definition_of_done: Key messages and offers per segment defined
Preferred channels and timing outlined
Plan validated with membership manager and marketing manager

backlog.task: Prepare FAQ and escalation matrix for customer service and front-line staff
definition_of_done: FAQ covers at least 30 common questions
Escalation paths and SLAs defined
Document shared with customer service manager for sign-off

backlog.task: Run quick audit of current membership data quality for target segments
definition_of_done: Data completeness and accuracy report produced
Key issues and root causes summarized
Priority clean-up actions identified and assigned

backlog.task: Define sales targets and simple incentive rules linked to new tiers
definition_of_done: Tier-specific sales targets drafted
Incentive rules aligned with existing compensation framework
Proposal reviewed with finance manager

backlog.task: Pilot new membership tiers with a small group of existing members
definition_of_done: Pilot cohort and duration defined
Feedback collection method agreed
Pilot results summarized with recommendations

backlog.task: Align cross-team launch timeline and key milestones
definition_of_done: Milestone plan covering design, training, pilot, and full launch created
Dependencies between sales and membership tasks mapped
Timeline approved by all key stakeholders

backlog.task: Set up weekly performance review cadence for first 8 weeks post-launch
definition_of_done: Core KPIs and reporting cadence defined
Meeting format and participants agreed
First two review dates scheduled

project.title: Launch of New Medical Device Education & Sales Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a coordinated education-driven sales program for a new medical device across key healthcare accounts.
deliverables: Segmented target account list with priority tiers
Educational slide deck and product training materials for clinicians
Standardised sales call script and objection-handling guide
Digital outreach plan for social media and email campaigns
KPI dashboard template for tracking leads, demos and orders
Post-launch review report with recommendations
constraints: All materials must comply with medical device promotion regulations
No off-label claims or unapproved indications in any content
Initial pilot must be ready within 21 days
Use only approved clinical data and references
Budget limits in-person events to existing key accounts
All customer interactions must be logged in the CRM

risks.risk: Educational content or sales scripts breach promotional regulations.
risks.mitigation: Have regulatory and medical affairs review and approve all materials before use.

risks.risk: Healthcare professionals show low engagement with the new program.
risks.mitigation: Pilot with a small group of receptive accounts, gather feedback, and refine messaging and format.

risks.risk: Sales team adoption of new scripts and tracking is inconsistent.
risks.mitigation: Run short mandatory training, share quick-reference guides, and monitor CRM usage weekly.

risks.risk: Delays in obtaining final clinical data and claims for the device.
risks.mitigation: Prepare draft materials with placeholders and lock timelines with medical affairs early.

themes.why_relevant: All sales and education content must respect medical device promotion rules.
Program relies on clinical education to drive adoption rather than pure price selling.
Focusing on the right hospitals and clinics is key to early traction.
Common scripts, tracking and KPIs enable consistent execution and measurement.
Sales and education roles must align on content, events and feedback loops.

project.title: Standardised Accounting and Inventory Process for Moving Services
project.objective: Design and roll out a standard process to link moving jobs with accurate bookkeeping and basic inventory tracking for a small moving services unit.
deliverables: Documented end-to-end process from booking a move to final invoice and posting
Standard chart of accounts and tax-compliant posting rules for moving services
Templates for sales invoices, quotes, and basic job cost summaries
Simple inventory and tools tracking procedure for movers
Training session and quick-reference guides for bookkeepers and movers
constraints: Must comply with tax legislation and bookkeeping regulations for service companies
Process must be usable by movers with minimal admin time on-site
All tools must be trackable without new paid software
Solution must be auditable and align with company policies and commercial law
Initial rollout must be ready for pilot within 21 days

risks.risk: Movers do not consistently follow new packing and inventory recording steps.
risks.mitigation: Create very simple checklists, provide short training, and gather early feedback to simplify steps.

risks.risk: Incorrect tax treatment of moving services on invoices.
risks.mitigation: Bookkeepers validate tax rules with tax advisor and document clear VAT/tax codes in guidelines.

risks.risk: Process adds too much admin work for bookkeepers during peak periods.
risks.mitigation: Automate repetitive entries via templates and batch posting rules; pilot with limited volume first.

risks.risk: Data from movers (weights, items, hours) is incomplete or inaccurate.
risks.mitigation: Define minimum mandatory fields and add validation checks in job sheets before invoicing.

themes.why_relevant: Need a clean handover from movers to bookkeepers so every job is invoiced and posted correctly.

themes.theme: Compliance with tax and bookkeeping regulations
themes.why_relevant: Moving services must be invoiced and recorded in line with statutory obligations and tax law.
Movers have limited time; forms and checklists must be quick and intuitive to use on-site.
Bookkeepers must quickly spot and fix accounting and data errors from job records.
Both movers and bookkeepers need clear guidance and short training to adopt the new process.

backlog.task: Map current workflow from move booking to invoice and ledger posting
definition_of_done: All current steps documented for at least 5 recent moves
Pain points and gaps between movers and bookkeepers listed
Reviewed with one mover and one bookkeeper for accuracy

backlog.task: Design standard job sheet for movers including inventory and time data
definition_of_done: Job sheet template created with required fields for items, hours, distance
Fields validated by at least one bookkeeper for accounting needs
Pilot version tested on 2 moves and feedback captured

backlog.task: Create standard chart of accounts and posting rules for moving services
definition_of_done: List of relevant accounts for moving revenue, costs, and tools agreed
Posting rules for typical transactions documented
Tax codes and VAT treatment defined and checked against legislation

backlog.task: Develop invoice and quote templates for moving jobs
definition_of_done: Invoice template includes mandatory legal fields and tax details
Quote template aligned with final invoice structure
Templates tested with 3 sample jobs and totals reconciled

backlog.task: Define simple tools and equipment tracking procedure for movers
definition_of_done: Checklist for tools before and after each job created
Procedure fits within existing loading/unloading routine
At least 2 movers confirm it is practical to use daily

backlog.task: Draft accounting and compliance guideline for the new process
definition_of_done: Guideline covers invoicing, posting, and document retention
References relevant tax and commercial law requirements
Reviewed by accounting manager or equivalent role

backlog.task: Run joint training session for movers and bookkeepers
definition_of_done: Training agenda and materials prepared
At least one session delivered with both roles present
Attendance and key questions documented for follow-up

backlog.task: Pilot the new process on a limited set of moving jobs
definition_of_done: At least 5 moves processed using new job sheets and templates
All related invoices issued and posted using new rules
List of issues and improvement ideas compiled

backlog.task: Set up error log and correction workflow for accounting issues
definition_of_done: Simple log format for errors and corrections created
Process for reporting and resolving errors agreed with movers
First 10 logged issues show status and resolution steps

backlog.task: Refine process and templates based on pilot feedback
definition_of_done: Feedback from movers and bookkeepers consolidated
At least 3 concrete improvements applied to templates or steps
Updated versions shared and version-controlled

backlog.task: Create quick-reference one-pagers for movers and bookkeepers
definition_of_done: One-pager for movers with key steps and do's/don'ts created
One-pager for bookkeepers with posting rules summary created
Both documents validated against full guideline

backlog.task: Agree go-live date and support plan for wider rollout
definition_of_done: Go-live date confirmed with operations and accounting
Support contact and escalation path defined
Plan for first 2 weeks of monitoring documented

project.title: Launch of Unified B2B Service Bundles
project.objective: Design and launch a unified portfolio of B2B service bundles with clear pricing, SLAs, and go-to-market plan to increase uptake and simplify sales.
deliverables: Defined catalog of B2B service bundles with features and SLAs
Pricing and discount structure with margin analysis
Go-to-market and channel marketing plan
Supplier and outsourcing engagement plan
Launch readiness checklist and sign-off report
constraints: Launch date fixed to upcoming quarterly sales kick-off
Must maintain or improve current gross margin targets
Compliance with existing company policies and legal standards
Limited budget for external agencies and consultants
Bundles must be operable within current ERP and billing systems

risks.risk: Pricing misaligned with market expectations leading to low adoption.
risks.mitigation: Run quick market benchmarking and pilot pricing review with sales and finance before final sign-off.

risks.risk: Operational teams not ready to deliver new bundles at launch.
risks.mitigation: Create detailed launch readiness checklist and secure sign-off from operations and support leads.

risks.risk: Suppliers unable to meet new SLA requirements in bundles.
risks.mitigation: Engage key suppliers early, negotiate updated terms, and define fallback options for critical components.

risks.risk: Scope creep adding too many bundle variants and delaying launch.
risks.mitigation: Freeze MVP bundle list by mid-project and park additional ideas in a post-launch roadmap.

themes.why_relevant: Core to deciding which services are grouped, target segments, and value proposition.
Ensures bundles are competitive while meeting financial targets and budget constraints.
External partners must support SLAs, capacity, and cost structure of new bundles.
Drives awareness and adoption across direct and indirect sales channels.
Keeps cross-functional work on track to hit the fixed launch date.

project.title: Launch of Company-Wide Hybrid Onboarding Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardized hybrid (online + in-person) onboarding program to improve new hire ramp-up and consistency across departments.
deliverables: Standardized onboarding curriculum and schedule for first 30 days
Set of online training modules and facilitator guides
Onboarding toolkit for managers and buddies
Evaluation framework with surveys and assessment forms
Communication plan for rollout and change management
constraints: Program must be ready for pilot within 21 days
Content must comply with labour legislation and internal HR policies
Training time per new hire capped at 8 hours in first week
Materials must be usable for both remote and on-site employees
Limited availability of managers for live sessions (max 2 hours per week)

risks.risk: Managers do not adopt the new onboarding flow and revert to old habits.
risks.mitigation: Include managers in design feedback, provide a simple toolkit, and track completion via light reporting.

risks.risk: Training content is too generic and not relevant to different departments.
risks.mitigation: Run quick needs assessment interviews and add optional role-specific modules.

risks.risk: New hires experience information overload in the first week.
risks.mitigation: Stagger modules over 30 days and clearly label what is mandatory vs. optional.

risks.risk: Compliance topics are not fully covered or updated.
risks.mitigation: Have a human resources officer review all legal and policy-related content before rollout.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures all new hires receive consistent, compliant information regardless of team or location.
Hybrid workforce needs a mix of synchronous and asynchronous learning to fit schedules.
Onboarding success depends on managers and buddies following through on their responsibilities.
Surveys and assessments are needed to refine the program and show impact to leadership.
Clear messaging reduces confusion and resistance when introducing the new onboarding model.

definition_of_done: Checklist covers contracts, payroll setup, system access, and mandatory forms

project.title: Crisis Communication Playbook for On‑Site Security Incidents
project.objective: Design and roll out a clear, multi-channel crisis communication playbook for security-related incidents at company sites.
deliverables: Crisis communication playbook covering 5 main incident types
On-site security incident reporting and escalation script
Media and stakeholder holding statements library
Internal staff briefing and training materials
Simulation drill plan and evaluation template
Post-incident review and improvement procedure
constraints: Playbook must align with legal and safety regulations for security operations
All materials must be understandable by non-specialist on-site staff
Media responses must be pre-approved by legal and compliance teams
Solution must work for 24/7 operations with limited on-site equipment
Initial version must be ready before the next quarterly safety drill
All external messaging must be consistent across languages and channels

risks.risk: On-site staff misunderstand escalation steps during an incident.
risks.mitigation: Create simple checklists, run short trainings, and test with tabletop exercises before rollout.

risks.risk: Media statements conflict with legal or regulatory requirements.
risks.mitigation: Involve legal counsel in template drafting and set mandatory approval workflow.

risks.risk: Inconsistent messaging across spokespersons and channels.
risks.mitigation: Centralize key messages in a shared library and define a clear sign-off process.

risks.risk: Playbook is too complex to use under stress.
risks.mitigation: User-test with security staff, simplify language, and provide quick-reference one-pagers.

themes.why_relevant: Defines how security staff trigger communication workflows during crises.
Spokespersons and PR must align on what to say, when, and through which channels.
Security and public statements must respect law and internal policies.
Staff must practice the playbook so they can follow it under pressure.
Need clear separation and coordination between staff updates and public messaging.
Post-incident reviews refine the playbook over time.

backlog.task: Map typical on-site security incident scenarios and current response gaps
definition_of_done: At least 5 incident types documented with current handling steps
Pain points and communication gaps listed for each scenario
Validated with one security guard representative

backlog.task: Draft crisis communication playbook structure and ownership matrix
definition_of_done: Table of contents agreed by PR and spokespersons
RACI/ownership matrix defined for each incident phase
Reviewed by operations manager and updated accordingly

backlog.task: Create simple incident reporting and escalation script for security staff
definition_of_done: Step-by-step script written in plain language

Legal and safety teams confirm no conflicting instructions

backlog.task: Develop media holding statements and Q&A templates for key scenarios
definition_of_done: At least one holding statement per incident type drafted
Top 10 likely media questions with suggested answers prepared
Legal counsel signs off on all templates

definition_of_done: Short briefing notes template created for internal updates

Pilot briefing tested with small internal group and feedback captured

backlog.task: Prepare training session content for security and front-line staff
definition_of_done: Training deck and facilitator notes completed

At least one dry run completed with PR or spokesperson present

backlog.task: Define multi-channel communication strategy for crises
definition_of_done: Channels per incident type and severity mapped
Approval flow for social, web, and press defined
Alignment confirmed with spokesperson team

definition_of_done: One-page checklist per incident type produced
Font and layout suitable for print and mobile
Reviewed and approved by security operations lead

backlog.task: Set up schedule and format for crisis simulation drills
definition_of_done: Drill objectives and scenarios documented
Timeline and participants list agreed with operations
Evaluation criteria and feedback form prepared

backlog.task: Document post-incident review and improvement process
definition_of_done: Standard review template created
Roles and timing for reviews defined
Process communicated to security and communication teams

backlog.task: Align external messaging with community relations priorities
definition_of_done: Key community concerns identified and listed
Messaging adjusted to address concerns without legal risk
Sign-off obtained from senior management

backlog.task: Consolidate final playbook and distribute to stakeholders
definition_of_done: All sections merged into a single document
Version control and access rights configured
Distribution list confirmed and playbook shared

project.title: Sustainable Housing Portfolio Optimisation Initiative
project.objective: Design and roll out a sustainability-focused optimisation plan for the housing portfolio, improving occupancy, service quality, and environmental performance while controlling costs.
deliverables: Current-state assessment of housing portfolio, logistics and service operations
Sustainability and efficiency strategy for housing and related services
Green ICT roadmap for tenant and facilities digital services
Quality and compliance framework for housing operations and suppliers
Financial and KPI dashboard for monitoring portfolio performance
Implementation rollout plan with phased milestones and responsibilities
constraints: Must comply with housing, safety and data protection regulations
Limited capex budget for upgrades in the first 12 months
Minimal disruption to current tenants and service levels
Need to align with existing corporate sustainability targets
ICT changes must integrate with current core systems
Executive board expects initial results within the first quarter

risks.risk: Tenant resistance to operational or digital changes.
risks.mitigation: Run early communication, pilot in one building, gather feedback and adjust rollout.

risks.risk: ICT integration issues delay green digital initiatives.
risks.mitigation: Phase integrations, prioritise low-dependency features, involve ICT early in design.

risks.risk: Budget overruns due to underestimated retrofit or process costs.
risks.mitigation: Create conservative cost estimates, add contingency, stage investments by impact.

risks.risk: Quality or compliance gaps discovered during audits.
risks.mitigation: Run internal pre-audits, implement corrective action plans, standardise procedures.

risks.risk: Lack of alignment between sustainability goals and operational KPIs.
risks.mitigation: Co-define KPIs with leadership, embed them in dashboards and performance reviews.

themes.why_relevant: Occupancy and satisfaction drive revenue and must be protected during optimisation.
Green ICT consultant leads digital and environmental improvements across the portfolio.
Quality engineering technician ensures processes and suppliers meet standards and audits.
Business consultant and CEO need clear ROI, KPIs and budget control for the initiative.
Housing manager must coordinate staff and tenants through operational changes.
Different roles must align on priorities, trade-offs and decision-making cadence.

project.title: In-Store Customer Experience and Merchandising Refresh
project.objective: Improve in-store customer experience and product presentation to increase conversion and repeat visits across key product categories.
deliverables: Standardised product display layouts for top-selling categories
Customer guidance scripts for common enquiries and complaints
Weekly stock and facing checklist for sales floor staff
Simple aftersales and follow-up process for priority customers
Short training huddle plan for new merchandising standards
constraints: All changes must be implementable during normal shifts with no extra staffing
No changes that require store remodelling or new fixtures
Customer service scripts must comply with existing company policies
New routines must be testable in-store within 3 weeks
Stock handling must follow current safety and loss-prevention rules

risks.risk: New display standards slow down daily replenishment and cause delays on the shop floor.
risks.mitigation: Pilot layouts in one area, collect feedback from sales assistants, and simplify steps before full rollout.

risks.risk: Customer guidance scripts feel too rigid and reduce natural interaction.
risks.mitigation: Frame scripts as prompts, gather examples from staff, and allow adaptation within policy limits.

risks.risk: Inconsistent adoption of new checklists across shifts.
risks.mitigation: Create a simple checklist format, assign shift leads to sign off, and review completion weekly.

risks.risk: Stock availability issues undermine improved merchandising.
risks.mitigation: Align new displays with current stock levels and add a quick escalation rule for low-stock items.

themes.why_relevant: Sales assistants need clear, consistent ways to advise customers and suggest suitable products.
Organised, attractive displays help customers find items quickly and support higher sales.
Good displays fail if shelves are empty; staff must link merchandising with stock checks.
Simple follow-up routines can turn one-time buyers into repeat customers and reduce complaints.
New standards must fit into daily opening, peak, and closing routines across all shifts.

backlog.task: Map current customer questions and common issues at the sales counter and on the floor.
definition_of_done: At least 20 frequent questions or issues listed from recent shifts
Grouped into 5–7 themes (e.g. sizing, returns, product use)
Shared in channel and validated by at least two other sales assistants

backlog.task: Draft customer guidance prompts for top 5 product categories.
definition_of_done: For each category, 3–5 opening questions to identify needs are written

project.title: Launch of Corporate Safety & Sustainability Awareness Campaign
project.objective: Design and roll out a cross-channel internal campaign to improve staff awareness of safety, security and sustainability practices across all sites.
deliverables: Campaign strategy and messaging framework
Internal launch event and activation plan
Content kit for digital channels and on-site signage
Quality and compliance checklist for campaign materials
Post-campaign evaluation report with improvement actions
constraints: All content must comply with legal and safety regulations
Campaign must be launch-ready within 21 days
Limited budget for physical materials and events
Messages must be understandable for non-specialist staff
Need alignment with existing corporate branding guidelines

risks.risk: Low employee engagement with the campaign content.
risks.mitigation: Use interactive formats, on-site activations and feedback loops; involve local champions in promotion.

risks.risk: Messages conflict with existing safety or security procedures.
risks.mitigation: Have security and safety officers review and sign off all materials before publication.

risks.risk: Tight timeline causes rushed, low-quality deliverables.
risks.mitigation: Prioritise critical channels, use a clear backlog and timebox reviews with defined owners.

risks.risk: Inconsistent messaging across digital, print and events.
risks.mitigation: Create a central messaging framework and style guide; route all assets through quality review.

themes.why_relevant: Core content of the campaign; must be accurate, practical and aligned with on-site procedures.
Need to balance digital, on-site and live events to reach different staff groups effectively.
Ensures materials meet legal, safety and brand standards before rollout.
Internal launch events and activations are key to driving awareness and engagement.
Post-campaign data and feedback will guide follow-up actions and next iterations.

project.title: Launch of Community Eco-Finance Awareness Week
project.objective: Plan and execute a week-long community event series on sustainable finance, postal and bakery services, improving customer engagement and cross-promotion.
deliverables: Eco-Finance Awareness Week event schedule and venue plan

constraints: Event must run within one calendar week next month

risks.risk: Low community turnout leading to poor engagement.

risks.mitigation: Have compliance officer pre-approve all materials and train staff on do/don't guidelines.

risks.risk: Operational disruption at postal and bakery counters during peak hours.
risks.mitigation: Schedule activities in off-peak slots and create a staffing rota with backups.

risks.risk: Inconsistent messaging across branches and touchpoints.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures consistent messaging across in-person, print and digital touchpoints during the campaign.
